title: Changed which hooks report a row inserted next to a top-level row through the `nestedRows` context menu. That insert no longer runs through `alter()`, so `beforeAlter` and `beforeDataSplice` no longer fire for it, matching the `Insert child row` and nested-child paths, which never fired them. `beforeCreateRow`, `afterCreateRow` and `beforeAddChild`/`afterAddChild` are unaffected, and returning `false` from `beforeCreateRow` still cancels the insert.
